title: New build2 baseline
item: New baseline: three build2 trials of the switched skill on Harbor Goods, graded
motivation: Every later skill change is compared against it
notes: Baseline = switch-base-10..12 (0c27a00), effort high. Took two fix rounds and a stand-in fix (8b61191). key_recall 0.44–0.67, reported only. The five product questions were not put to the owner; they wait for a real rebuild of Harbor Goods.
